title: Inspector run_cells
description: The parallel runnable-snippet map. Keyed by the SAME atomic element ids as verify_map.json. Each entry is a self-contained Python snippet the Inspector can execute in-browser (Pyodide) and grade against its expected_stdout. See _doc for the discipline every snippet must obey.

_doc.description: The discipline that makes a snippet runnable. Optional but recommended as the first key.

purpose.const: run_cells.json holds the in-browser-runnable version of each computation element in verify_map.json (same ids). The Inspector's 'Run' button executes runnable entries via a lazily-loaded Pyodide and compares stdout to expected_stdout.

self_contained.const: SELF-CONTAINED: every input the snippet needs is inlined as a Python literal in `code`. No file reads, no network, no dependence on other cells or page state.

pyodide_imports_only.const: PYODIDE-SAFE IMPORTS ONLY: numpy, pandas, and the Python standard library (math, json, itertools, collections, ...). No requests, no urllib network use, no third-party packages outside numpy/pandas.

pre_tested.const: PRE-TESTED: the snippet has been run and `code` reproduces `expected_stdout` exactly (byte-for-byte after normalising trailing newline). A snippet that does not reproduce its expected_stdout must not ship.

reduced_n_rule.const: HEAVY COMPUTE -> reduced_n: if the published figure needs a large sample (Monte-Carlo etc.), the in-browser snippet runs a SMALLER reduced_n and is graded '≈ within noise', NEVER a hard PASS. The exact, full-N version lives in the notebook (see full_ref).

network_rule.const: needs_network:true  ==>  runnable:false. A network-backed element is rendered READ-ONLY (code shown for inspection) and points the reader to the notebook cell named in full_ref; it is never executed in the browser.

id_parity.const: Keys mirror verify_map.json. Every runnable id here SHOULD have a 'computation' entry there; media/generated/fact ids do not appear in run_cells.

byte_identity.const: run_cells.json must be byte-identical to the inline `runCells` <script> island embedded in index.html. This file is the on-disk source of truth.

runnable.description: true => the Inspector may execute `code` in-browser. MUST be false whenever needs_network is true.

reduced_n.description: In-browser sample size for a stochastic snippet (smaller than the published N). null for exact/derived snippets. When set, grading is approximate ('≈ within noise'), not PASS.

lang.description: Only python is executable in the Pyodide sandbox.

code.description: The self-contained snippet. All inputs inlined; imports limited to numpy/pandas/stdlib; pre-tested to reproduce expected_stdout.

expected_stdout.description: The literal stdout the snippet prints (the grading target). May be empty string only for needs_network:true / runnable:false read-only entries.

note.description: Optional: explains the reduction (what was approximated) or why the snippet is exact, so a reader knows how to read the comparison.

needs_network.description: true => the underlying computation needs the network; forces runnable:false.

full_ref.description: Pointer to the full, exact reproduction: the source script (with its full N/seed) and the notebook cell tag that runs the full version.

allOf.description: needs_network:true forces runnable:false (network-backed snippets render read-only).
